summary: Grupo Aval Acciones y Valores S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a notice of relevant information dated October 1, 2026, stating that the October 2026 dividend payment was made in line with the profit distribution approved by the General Shareholders Meeting held March 27, 2026. No price per share, stake, premium, advisor, or transaction terms were disclosed. This is a routine dividend payment disclosure, analogous to a US Form 8-K Item 8.01 current report, and does not constitute a special situation.
